title: TDS affiliate benchmark decision evidence
research_boundaries: 17 official primary comparator sources; no independently verified current traffic ranking.
TIWIB public GETs returned Angular shell; indexed official content supplements markup. Asset/content requests returning403 were not retried or bypassed.
Unresolved template expressions and hidden default-zero metrics are excluded as performance evidence.
Wirecutter article bodies were robots-blocked. SEC filings, official publisher Help and NYT-authored Apple Podcasts metadata supply the evidence; no bypass.
No tracked merchant redirect was followed and no checkout, account dashboard or form was used.
Exact current card layout, final merchant links, prices, stock and checkout outcomes are not independently verified.
Public report excludes private account identifiers, channel metrics, payloads and credentials.

evidence: Named-item cards with save and merchant actions in indexed content

limitations: Direct current read is an Angular shell; unresolved values and hidden zero metrics are not performance evidence
Current visual layout and resolved merchant hrefs not independently audited

evidence: Free discovery magazine; no inventory or direct retail sale

limitations: No audited traffic period,actual CTR,CVR,earnings or promised sales verified

self_challenge_rounds.challenge: Why would a buyer use six cards instead of the original merchant pages?
self_challenge_rounds.decision: Task-first comparison, fit limitations, reuse/no-purchase option, local destination and measurement tool; no invented inner capacity or best-product claim.

self_challenge_rounds.challenge: How can mostly noncommissionable options produce USD100, and could more clicks still produce no income?
self_challenge_rounds.decision: Keep useful official choices, restrict monetized exact models to verified identity, solve independent attribution and qualified distribution, treat revenue scenarios as assumptions; no unready paid product or pitch business.

examples.name: Small accessory, weak unverified funnel

target.measure: Modeled affiliate contribution to TDS total site revenue; confirmed net after reversals; before operating costs; cash separate

caveats: Basket is commissionable revenue after excluded taxes, shipping and adjustments, not the consumer retail total. One modeled category per order is a simplifying assumption.
Category rate and product classification must be checked with Amazon; a guide category or search term does not establish an eligible category or account-specific rate.
Every conversion, qualification and refund rate is an assumption. Counts are successive rounded planning volumes, not guaranteed results or a time-to-revenue forecast.
Qualification rate is the fraction of placed merchant orders eligible before returns; refund rate applies to that subset. Required merchant clicks use merchant-reported clicks, not site click events.
The confirmed goal is USD100 total site revenue per calendar month. This scenario models affiliate contribution only. Shared US/DE tags establish account totals, not TDS earnings.
Zero observed conversion cannot be inverted into a finite forecast. Per-item rounding, mixed baskets and later reversals require actual merchant reports.
